people.text: Erika wants to see a show with music and which has famous actors in the lead roles. She'd like it to be based on a book and contain many different types of music.
Guillermo would like to go to a show that's funny and is about a real person. He's looking for one with some music in it, but with more speaking than singing.
Neelam wants to see a musical show which contains lots of special effects and would like to watch it in an unusual place. She'd like to see a love story.
Oumar wants to go to a show that's a bit frightening. He'd like to see a story set in the past and realistic costumes from the period.
Mira wants a show with dancing, as well as songs by well-known musicians. She'd like the music to be in a range of styles from around the world.

items.label: A
items.title: Glad!
items.text: Tells the story of a teenage girl whose dreams of becoming a famous musician come true with the help of some special (and amusing!) friends. The costumes and songs are amazing, and although it's fiction, it has the feel of a real-life story. It's on for one week only, on a temporary stage in the football stadium.

items.label: B
items.title: Mary Wright
items.text: The two well-known lead actors in this 16th-century drama are surprisingly good dancers, and the music creates quite a scary atmosphere. The clothes by top designer JeanLuc Filbert are historically correct and look absolutely wonderful.

items.label: C
items.title: The Amazing Mr Mason
items.text: This unusual musical is based on a famous story written over 400 years ago. The hero falls in love with a princess who's forced to move to another country. There's quite a lot of speaking for a musical, but the ending's a surprising pleasure.

items.label: D
items.title: The End of Summer
items.text: You've probably read the novel which this musical comedy takes its story from, but you won't recognise the songs, as they were specially written for the show. Several songwriters were needed, due to the wide variety of music the producers wanted. The stars, who you'll probably recognise from TV, are fantastic.

items.label: E
items.title: Keeping Time
items.text: Based on the real-life story of the popular group Marcellous, and includes their best work. We see how having members from three different continents allowed them to create songs using music from each place. Unusually, there's ballet in this show, which goes surprisingly well with their music.

items.label: F
items.title: No Exit
items.text: With its use of film and advanced technology to make it seem like the characters appear in two places at once, this spectacular musical starts off as an old-fashioned ghost story but quickly turns into a highly entertaining romantic comedy. The fact that the show is performed in an old factory building only adds to the enjoyment.

items.label: G
items.title: Tiger Prince
items.text: The Tiger Prince leaves his jungle home and comes to the city in this fabulous musical. The story isn't particularly original but the computer-controlled light show goes perfectly with the amazing dance routines to make this a must-see show.

items.label: H
items.title: The Final Whistle
items.text: If you're tired of serious dramas and dull love stories, why not give this laugh-a-minute show a try? The true story of basketball player Andy Hammond is cleverly told. Despite being advertised as a musical show, it actually has very few songs. You'll love the lively and entertaining conversations.

explanations.6: Erika 想看有音乐、主演是著名演员且基于一本书的演出，包含多种类型音乐。D 剧《The End of Summer》基于小说改编，由多位作曲家创作不同风格音乐，主演是电视明星，符合需求。“based on a famous story... several songwriters were needed, due to the wide variety of music... the stars, who you'll probably recognise from TV, are fantastic.” 对应 “based on a book... many different types of music... famous actors”。
explanations.7: Guillermo 想看有趣、关于真实人物且有一些音乐但说比唱多的演出。H 剧《The Final Whistle》讲述篮球运动员真实故事，虽为音乐剧但歌曲少，对话生动有趣，符合要求。“the true story of basketball player Andy Hammond... despite being advertised as a musical show, it actually has very few songs... lively and entertaining conversations.” 对应 “funny... about a real person... more speaking than singing”。
explanations.8: Neelam 想看有很多特效、在不寻常地方演出的爱情故事音乐剧。F 剧《No Exit》使用电影和先进技术制造特效，在旧工厂演出，是浪漫喜剧，符合需求。“with its use of film and advanced technology to make it seem like the characters appear in two places at once... performed in an old factory building... romantic comedy.” 对应 “special effects... unusual place... love story”。
explanations.9: Oumar 想看有点吓人、以过去为背景且有符合时代的逼真服装的演出。B 剧《Mary Wright》是 16 世纪戏剧，音乐营造可怕氛围，服装由顶级设计师设计且符合历史，符合要求。“16th-century drama... the music creates quite a scary atmosphere... the clothes... are historically correct and look absolutely wonderful.” 对应 “frightening... set in the past... realistic costumes”。
explanations.10: Mira 想看有舞蹈和著名音乐家歌曲、音乐风格多样的演出。E 剧《Keeping Time》基于真实乐队故事，成员来自三大洲，融合不同地区音乐，有芭蕾，符合需求。“based on the real-life story of the popular group Marcellous... having members from three different continents allowed them to create songs using music from each place... there's ballet in this show.” 对应 “dancing... songs by well-known musicians... range of styles from around the world”。
